author: Gianna Cefalu
title: Ridge Spring-Monetta's Dylan Harris named Scholar Athlete - NewsBreak
text: MONETTA, SC (WJBF)- It’s that time of year again for our scholar athlete awards, where we honor student athletes that excel in the classroom and community. This week’s is Dylan Harris from Ridge Spring-Monetta High School. Dylan carries a whopping 5.119 GPA and is a member of both the football and track teams. A two-year starter on the trojans offensive line, he was their highest graded o-linemen overall last season. On the track, he throws shot and distance. In the classroom, he’s an early-graduate who plans to enroll at either USC-Aiken or USC-Columbia to study mechanical engineering. His mom and coaches are only expecting great things from here in his future. “I have to first give it to my family. They push me to be the best I can be. They help me succeed in everything I do, and I’d also like to thank my coaches on the field for pushing me to my fullest potential,” Harris said. “Words can’t express how proud I am of Dylan. Ridge Spring-Monetta is a family. So, everyone comes together. Everyone sticks together. He’s had a number of people to motivate him and to push him and always be around for support,” said Dylan’s mother Maretha. “It’s just been a real pleasure to watch him grow and mature and become the young man he is today, and I think he’s going to do great things in the future,” said head coach Jay Brannon. Dylan’s play on the football field helped the Trojans to a second-round appearance in last year’s state playoffs. For the latest news, weather, sports, and streaming video, head to WJBF.
